verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a reasonable capability for a remote-desktop and IT-support product to ship, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents only a CLI and a REST API for scripted automation of installation, sessions and account data. Neither is an AI assistant that a user can delegate tasks to, and they are developer building blocks rather than the capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
